notes: Typst publication checks independent raw, optimized/stripped, gzip and Brotli ceilings. The raw ceiling provides staging headroom. Published-artifact ceilings use the November 28 Linux measurements plus 3%, rounded up to 1,000 bytes. Compression uses the final stripped artifact. Web and Playground report sizes without ceilings. See docs/performance/typst_theme_budget_2026-11-05.md for the measurements and docs/performance/binding_wasm_budget_2026-11-01.md for historical Web figures.
